EDMP.description: Change Element Dependent Material Property (EDMP). Keyed by element number; TYPE selects the size-measure interpretation of the H_VS value used for time-dependent material property changes.

TYPE.description: Change property method (case-insensitive). "NSM" = Notional Size of Member; "VSR" = Volume-Surface Ratio.

H_VS.description: Change property value. For TYPE=NSM this is the notional size h; for TYPE=VSR this is the volume/surface ratio (v/s).
